# Glidepath

> Glidepath is Hangar's CI/CD engine on Tekton and Pipelines-as-Code. An app declares its build, test,
> deploy and release in one file, cicd.yaml; Glidepath runs it, gates every release behind independent
> checks and a human-reviewed gitops pull request, and records each release's state.

Read in this order for a cold start.

## Contract
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): what an agent may and may not do here
- [contract/glidepath-contract.json](contract/glidepath-contract.json): every cicd.yaml field and its agentScope, the release gates, the run and release states, the known failures (generated)
- [docs/admin/contract.md](docs/admin/contract.md): how the contract is built, glidepath validate's rules, what an agent may change
- [api/openapi.yaml](api/openapi.yaml) and [docs/admin/api.md](docs/admin/api.md): glidepath-api, an app's runs, logs, why a run failed (explain), release records, image evidence (signatures and attestations, re-verified) and test runs; its writes are re-run and cancel a PipelineRun (T1) and promote to or roll back a Flight environment (T2: starts the release Pipeline, a human merges its PR); all idempotent and dry-runnable

## Writing cicd.yaml
- [docs/user/cicd-yaml-reference.md](docs/user/cicd-yaml-reference.md): every field
- [docs/user/examples/](docs/user/examples/): complete files, minimal to production-grade
- [schemas/cicd.schema.json](schemas/cicd.schema.json): the schema the pipeline validates against

## How it works
- [docs/admin/architecture.md](docs/admin/architecture.md): the system, end to end
- [docs/admin/release.md](docs/admin/release.md): how a release becomes a gitops pull request
- [docs/admin/release-state.md](docs/admin/release-state.md): the release record and its state machine
- [docs/admin/release-guardrails.md](docs/admin/release-guardrails.md): the release gates
- [docs/admin/testing.md](docs/admin/testing.md): test steps, the check ride and the qa gate

## Optional
